'''Lee romays''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Clam/Legends|clam]]. One of them held the crown of the monarch of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. When [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] became king, Brother [[Lemcke/Legends|Lemcke]] presented it to him.
